backup_singer.description: One of the 6 backup singer types from SigSynth.BACKUP_TYPES (assets/synth.js). All are synthesized voices stacked by the vocal synth — never human singers.

shift.description: Semitone shift applied to the lead melody by renderVocal.

voice_profile.description: One of the 24 custom voice profiles in assets/synth.js (studio extension): man/woman/boy/girl x deep/light x low/mid/high. All are synthesized formant voices.

formants.description: Three formant filter frequencies (Hz) for the bandpass stack in singNote.

oct.description: Octave offset applied to melody MIDI notes.

description: The 4 created voices from SigSynth.CREATED_VOICES (assets/synth.js): Nova, Ember, Drift, Stone. JAH-VOICE-###### IDs are permanent and never reused. RULE (no-human-singers): every voice record's desc states the voice is synthesized.

desc.description: Always states the voice is synthesized. Current records: 'Bright airy synthesized soprano', 'Warm synthesized alto', 'Soft breathy synthesized tenor', 'Deep resonant synthesized bass'.

formants.description: Three formant bandpass frequencies (Hz) used by singNote.

id.description: Short engine id used by renderVocal(voiceId) and the vocal studio.

name.description: Display name: Nova | Ember | Drift | Stone.

version.description: Voice engine version. Current: 'v1' on all four voices.

title: Signature Music Studio — Voice record
